new_paragraph: As read on 28 October 2026, the ITO main page and current return guidance say Tax eService is temporarily unavailable and direct taxpayers to the editable PDF return by email; the public service listing above does not establish availability. The current IT1 covers income and outgoings for 1 July 2025–30 June 2026, with a separate election/allowance part for the year commencing 1 July 2026 and a stated receipt deadline of 30 November 2026. Its first-page routing table gives PAYE returns to **paye.returns@gibraltar.gov.gi**, Other returns to **taxopi@gibraltar.gov.gi**, and HEPSS returns to **taxqi@gibraltar.gov.gi**. It requires photo ID, says no taxpayer signature is needed, and rejects a return without ID. A representative supplies authority and name/capacity. The guidance recommends PDF, JPEG or PNG attachments and says paper/lobby-mailbox returns are not accepted. These are the published 2026 filing arrangements, not verified delivery receipts or an assertion that the future year-ending-June-2027 return is released. Follow the actual form year/type and retain submission and assessment evidence. [ITO notice](https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/income-tax-office); [IT1 first page](https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/uploads/Income%20Tax%20Office/Employers/Tax_ReturnForm2026.pdf); [return guidance, opening notice and pages 3, 10–12](https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/uploads/Income%20Tax%20Office/Tax%20Returns/Tax%20Return%20Guidance%202026_.pdf).
